why_this_packet_exists: F791 freezes the larger alpha_s selection-principle target and requires selection_objective_or_order_rule_ref.
P792 shows that one explicit order-rule tuple already isolates a unique current winner, but only at probe-local and nonexport level.

target_object.goal: Freeze the exact export-grade order-rule object needed before the current probe-local winner can fill selection_objective_or_order_rule_ref on the alpha_s lane.

required_fields.name: candidate_family_domain_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must point to one explicit finite alpha_s family domain; silent domain changes are forbidden.

required_fields.name: source_authority_rule_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must export the rule that orders basis-invariant full-spectrum sources against weaker projective pair-summary sources.

required_fields.name: normalization_boundary_rule_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must export the rule governing bounded normalized grids and explicit top-boundary anchoring.

required_fields.name: residual_tie_break_rule_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must either resolve residual ties deterministically or explicitly prove that no tie remains on the admitted domain.

required_fields.name: nonstrict_calibration_separation_ref
required_fields.hard_limit: Must keep geometric-mean proxy-to-GeV policy language on the nonstrict side unless a new strict theorem is exported.

required_fields.name: selected_family_output_schema
required_fields.hard_limit: Must output the selected family identifier and the exact admitted normalization rule.

required_fields.name: hard_limits
required_fields.hard_limit: Must explicitly deny Standard Model identification, QCD closure, and ToE closure.

current_honest_reading: P792 narrows the selection blocker from no-winner ambiguity to no-authority ambiguity.
